full_text: Tairona gold and stone pendant necklace from Colombia around 500 to 1500 AD.

formatting.caption: Tairona gold and stone pendant necklace from Colombia around 500 to 1500 AD.

images.description: Full photograph of the Tairona necklace - a long strand necklace with multiple carved stone and gold pendants depicting animal figures (frogs, birds, jaguars, and other creatures) in various colors including red, orange, cream, gray, and gold. The pendants are strung on a light-colored cord with small beads between them. The necklace is arranged in a curved display showing both strands.
